review.description: Native inspection and current/retained proposal views protect nested URL credentials and copied usernames with empty passwords, including encoded path components, encoded credentials beside readable public schemes and malformed boundaries. Both displayed redaction placeholders are refused before a proposal is saved. Safe nested public URL spelling, exact selectors, raw hidden-change freshness and explicit confirmation remain intact.
review.implementation: Native redaction now inspects every raw nested scheme and iteratively decodes distinct URL components and queues newly decoded schemes even beside readable schemes, including independently readable escapes around malformed components. Decoded-position tracking prevents escaped parameter delimiters from inventing shorter credentials. Further-encoded copied secrets are masked without changing safe public spellings. Discovery preserves literal plus signs in userinfo and raw/decoded copied values. Empty passwords retain the username credential. Projection sanitizes nested URL suffixes before their outer URL; credential-bearing encoded nested parameter values are removed while public nested values remain exact. Both generated redaction placeholders are refused before proposal persistence, including nested and copied occurrences. Raw freshness fingerprints, exact selectors/named identifiers, cached/background API ownership and cancellation remain unchanged. Startup applies the same checks to legacy entities and journal copies, preserving historical identity/state and transactional rollback without replay. Test-only transport polling adds an explicit30s readiness budget solely for the1000-source body-search fixture; ordinary calls retain5s. No production request path, cancellation, admission, response size or latency threshold changes.
review.tests: Inspected all eight native regression functions and their actual assertions. Seventy-three credential-boundary cases cover the existing malformed, quote, semicolon, whitespace and combined-URL boundaries plus raw/encoded/double-encoded/deep/path nested credentials, malformed encoded nested components, usernames with explicit empty passwords and partially escaped credentials. Each asserts inspection/persisted/legacy secrecy, URL and copied-value edit refusal, no extra persistence/native writes, and exact unrelated sandbox/partial-prefix preservation. Nineteen safe values assert exact inspection, proposal and one confirmed write, including encoded/double-encoded/deep/path nested public URLs and encoded public schemes beside readable schemes and ordinary prose. The edit-refusal test submits the actual displayed malformed-URL placeholder, its nested occurrence and a copied occurrence as well as the existing credential and ordinary placeholder cases. Actual startup migration runs ordinary, credential, URL-placeholder and three encoded-copy pending-edit variants with nested-password/empty-password username copies, encoded nested paths, mixed-scheme copies and readable-scheme/encoded-authority copies,37 eligible historical events across32-row pages, injected transactional rollback, unchanged identities/states, no native write and repeat idempotence. Focused native regressions and the full factory race suite must pass for the current correction; complete consumer suites remain required by reconciliation. No real-host acceptance is claimed. Inspected TestFactoryStatePagesCompactDataAndExplicitDelivery: original paging/count/body-elision/search/new-filter/session/detail/mutation/delivery assertions remain unchanged. A new controlled projection-cache lock holds preparation for6s: actual first HTTP read is pending and explicit preparation polling eventually returns the complete empty inbox. Existing useful-response API performance checks remain required.
